title: PowerPoint for Mac: customise the Presenter view layout
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and unchanged default layout are supported, and no feature-specific admin switch or licensing charge was found. The updated November 24 release notes still describe no Presenter view change. Minor corrections should add two supporting sources and distinguish app-update installation from Microsoft's gradual feature rollout.
